# Shapes that must NOT be reported

The document title carries the marker class. Metadata is not a placement site
at all — the marker machinery never reaches it — so nothing about it is
reported. A report that cannot tell metadata from the document body tells an
author something untrue, which is worse than saying nothing.

One term is marked here: [theta]{.index}.

A marker below the top level places nothing, and what it carried is spliced in
where it stood — so the container it was written in keeps that content.

::: {#keeps-content .surrounding}
::: {.qi-index-here}
Content the marker kept, which leaves this container non-empty.
:::
:::

A marker written beside something the author wrote empties nothing either, so
the report must stay silent here however the marker itself is handled.

::: {#keeps-sibling .surrounding}
A paragraph the author wrote, which survives the marker beside it.

::: {.qi-index-here}
:::
:::

A container the author left empty was never emptied by this extension, so it
is none of its business and draws no report.

::: {#author-empty .surrounding}
:::
